test_series_dtypes: test rolling window operations (count, max, min, sum, mean, std, var, median) on pandas Series across multiple dtypes including int, float, datetime, and category
test_series_nullable_int: test rolling mean on a pandas Series with nullable integer extension array dtype
test_dataframe_dtypes: test rolling window operations (count, max, min, sum, mean, std, var, median) on pandas DataFrame across multiple dtypes
test_rolling_datetime_error: test that rolling aggregation on datetime Series raises DataError for non-count methods
test_rolling_step_parameter: test rolling window operations with the step parameter for sub-sampling results
